nodes.norm_label: solicitacao.html — public stock movement request form

nodes.label: Supabase (Backend Platform: Auth, DB, Storage, Realtime)
nodes.norm_label: supabase (backend platform: auth, db, storage, realtime)

nodes.label: Auth Gate — Login / Password Recovery Screen (Fase 1)
nodes.rationale: Always renders dark regardless of the app's chosen theme, matching the brand's dark auth aesthetic; user signup is deliberately not self-service — accounts are created only by the ADM outside the app to keep access controlled.
nodes.norm_label: auth gate — login / password recovery screen (fase 1)

nodes.label: Realtime Activity Toast (Fase 5 — Realtime)
nodes.rationale: Sound + popup infrastructure shipped in this delivery but intentionally not wired to any event yet; the trigger logic is deferred to a later stage ('Etapa 3').

nodes.label: Mensagens (Chat) Popover
nodes.rationale: Etapa 1 ships only the visual shell without data logic; the 'Geral' conversation is hardcoded because it needs no dynamic data, while 1:1 conversations are meant to be injected later from profiles + presence data.

nodes.label: Admin — Formulário Público Section (public link + analyst/category routing)
nodes.norm_label: admin — formulario publico section (public link + analyst/category routing)

nodes.label: DAI Generator Modal (Documento de Ajuste de Inventário)
nodes.rationale: The DAI document has fiscal validity for accounting/audit purposes; generating one automatically opens matching Ocorrência record(s), already marked concluded (gold status), or pending if any item lacks an SAP number.
nodes.norm_label: dai generator modal (documento de ajuste de inventario)

nodes.label: Termo de Responsabilidade Step (sign + attach)
nodes.rationale: Requires printing, signing and re-uploading the responsibility term plus proof of the movement (weighing photo, collection note, etc.) before submission, so each informant is personally accountable for the declared information.
